This plugin is really cool! As an artist, I’ve run into a few issues while working with it and would like to suggest some improvements:

1. When using custom brushes, even if I set “brush color from” to 100, lowering the opacity of my selected color does not change the brush‑stroke opacity at all. It would be great if custom brushes could respect stroke‑opacity adjustments.
2. The zoom tool has some usability problems with drawing tablets. When I drag left, the view zooms in; dragging right zooms out. Most drawing programs work the opposite way —‑ drag‑left to zoom out, drag‑right to zoom in. This feels really counter‑intuitive once you are used to standard workflows. Also, switching the “mode” setting between “zoom out” and “zoom in” makes no visible difference. What’s more, dragging to zoom does not pivot around the cursor position. If I keep zooming in and out without releasing the pen, the view drifts steadily away from my original focal point. Mouse‑wheel zoom works correctly in this regard. I’d also love two extra preferences: zoom speed and zoom‑range limits. Right now zooming happens way too fast; I often accidentally zoom all the way out until I can barely see my artwork, which breaks my painting flow.
3. When “single tool mode” is enabled, the tool‑icon HUD shows up at the bottom‑left corner instead of centered on my cursor. Multiple overlapping icons can get confusing. This behaves differently from how most mainstream painting software handles single‑tool mode. Adding toggle‑style compatibility options here would help users coming from other apps.
4. The “interface” slider under the “contrast” setting lags badly. The slider is hard to drag and stutters while adjusting values.

# Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog. All the dates are in YYYY-MM-DD format.
 

## [v0.11.3] - 2023-10-30
This update has been brought to you by the contributions of:
Fayez Akhtar (@Variable-ind)

Built using Godot 3.5.2

### Changed
- When deleting a palette, a confirmation window now appears that lets users either to delete the palette permanently, move it to trash, or cancel. #914

### Fixed
- Fixed undo/redo history not working when the tool changes. #916
- Pixelorama no longer closes when the project fails to be saved if "Save & Exit" is selected. #920
- Projects with 3D cels saved in 1.x can now be opened in 0.11.3. #928

## [v0.11.2] - 2023-08-31
This update has been brought to you by the contributions of:
@Lsbt1, Fayez Akhtar (@Variable-ind)

Built using Godot 3.5.2

### Added
- An option for reference images to only appear as silhouettes. #898
- Snapping to the center of the rectangular grid is now possible. #905

### Fixed
- Fixed a critical bug causing data loss when moving around the tabs of opened projects and then saving them. #901
- Loading corrupt pxo files no longer crashes the program. #904

### Removed
- Pxo files saved with versions prior to v0.8 can no longer get loaded starting version 0.11.2. If you have old files that you need to load, load them in an earlier version first (from v0.8 to v0.11.1) and save them again. #904

## [v0.11.1] - 2023-08-12
This update has been brought to you by the contributions of:
Fayez Akhtar (@Variable-ind), @20kdc, Matteo Piovanelli (@MatteoPiovanelli-Laser)

Built using Godot 3.5.2

### Added
- A new offset image effect to easily move the image around, with animation support.
- Implemented a "smart slicer" system that lets the software automatically slice a spritesheet in separate frames on image import, without the user having to specify horizontal and vertical frames. #893
- Added optional integer zooming for the canvas, which can be enabled from the Preferences. Disabled by default. #894
- Fast way to clone frames of a tag. #861
- Added a reverse frames option on the right click menu of the frame buttons, to easily reverse the order of the selected frames.
- A new Timeline category in the Preferences with options such as the colors of onion skinning's color mode, and whether a layer should be selected when a layer button (such as lock, visibility etc) gets pressed.
- It is now possible to disable saving frames that have a tag to a different folder, as well as specifying a separator character in the file names.
- Palette file types now exist as filters in the Open file dialog.
- .bmp and .tga file types now exist in the Open dialog of the Web version.

### Changed
- The image effect animation system introduced in v0.11 has been overhauled with a better user interface, and with tweening options. #879
- Images stored in RAM for the undo/redo system when draw tools are used are now compressed. This reduces RAM usage. #890
- The cel opacity slider now affects all of the selected cels. #865
- The right click menu of the frame buttons now works for all selected frames, besides "move left" and "move right".
- The canvas is automatically enlarged when importing an image of a larger size to the project.
- Error codes are now being explained in the error messages. #891
- Newly cloned frames are now automatically selected. #861
- "Centralize Image" has been moved from the Image menu to the frame button right click menu. #884
- The project's name is no longer saved inside .pxo files. Loaded projects now get their name directly from the file name.

tool_input.content:
# Handoff: lápiz Inspiroy H640P no escribe en Pixelorama

Fecha: 2026-11-12. El lápiz mueve el cursor; al presionar no pinta. No usar Computer Use. Usar MCP `user-pixelorama`, `config.ini` y shell.

## Causa

Pixelorama 1.2.4 (Godot 4.7.1) está en **Windows Ink**. Con Huion eso es el fallo conocido: el cursor sigue el lápiz, los clics de UI a veces sirven, el lienzo no recibe el press.

Config actual:

`C:\Users\Romelt\AppData\Roaming\pixelorama\config.ini`

```
[preferences]
tablet_driver=1
```

En Godot 4.7 el índice 1 es `winink`. Índice 0 es `auto`. Después vienen `wintab` (si carga `wintab32.dll`) y `dummy`.

Casos iguales: Huion Inspiroy H1161 en Steam, issue [#1273](https://github.com/Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama/issues/1273), issue [#1009](https://github.com/Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama/issues/1009), [troubleshooting oficial](https://pixelorama.org/troubleshooting/#my-drawing-tablet-is-not-working). Arreglo: **Edit → Preferences → Drivers → `wintab`**. Si `wintab` no pinta, probar **`dummy`**.

Secundario en el mismo `config.ini`: `left_tool` y `right_tool` están en **Eraser**. Borrar sobre lienzo vacío parece que el lápiz no escribe. Tras cambiar el driver, dejar el lápiz (P) en una capa desbloqueada y visible.

## Lo que ya se comprobó

- `tablet_driver=1` (`winink`).
- Bridge en logs: `[PixeloramaBridge] listening on 127.0.0.1:7373`. `get_status` de este chat devolvió `bridge unavailable: AggregateException`.
- El MCP **no** tiene herramienta para cambiar el driver de tableta.
- `dynamics_size` por presión no explica el síntoma: con presión 0 el pincel sigue en `_brush_size`.
- No se cambió `config.ini`. Pixelorama estaba abierto; al cerrar podría pisar el archivo.
- No se tocó el driver Huion ni se reinició Pixelorama.

## Qué hacer (en este orden)

1. En Pixelorama: **Edit → Preferences → Drivers → Tablet Driver = `wintab`**. Cerrar Preferences.
2. En HuionTablet: **desactivar Enable Windows Ink** (WinTab y Windows Ink no pueden ir a la vez). Reiniciar el driver Huion si hace falta.
3. Cerrar Pixelorama del todo y abrirlo de nuevo. Comprobar trazo con el lápiz (P) en una capa editable.
4. Si sigue sin pintar: Drivers → **`dummy`**, reiniciar Pixelorama.
5. Si `wintab` no aparece: HuionTablet → Settings → Version Info → Software Diagnosis → Repair de WinTab32, luego el paso 1.

El MCP no sustituye el press del lápiz. Sirve para dibujar por comandos (`draw_pixels`, `draw_line`, `draw_rect`) cuando el puente responda.

## Si el puente sigue caído

Comprobar `127.0.0.1:7373`. Si un cierre forzado apagó la extensión, cerrar Pixelorama y borrar:

- `C:\Users\Romelt\AppData\Roaming\pixelorama\.running`
- `C:\Users\Romelt\AppData\Roaming\pixelorama\extensions\Monitoring.ini`

Luego abrir Pixelorama otra vez. No borrar la carpeta de extensiones con un delete recursivo.

## No hacer

- No usar Computer Use.
- No editar `config.ini` con Pixelorama abierto (se pierde al salir).
- No dejar `winink` en Pixelorama y Windows Ink desactivado en Huion, ni al revés.

## Siguiente acción

Romelt cambia el driver a `wintab` (o `dummy`) en Preferences, alinea Windows Ink en Huion, reinicia Pixelorama y prueba un trazo. Si el MCP sigue en `AggregateException`, reabrir Pixelorama y repetir `get_status` desde un chat nuevo.

Handoff en `reports/HANDOFF-H640P.md`.

El lápiz no pinta porque Pixelorama está en **Windows Ink** (`tablet_driver=1`). Con la Inspiroy H640P el cursor se mueve y el lienzo no recibe el press. Además, izquierda y derecha están en **Eraser**.

Siguiente paso, sin Computer Use: **Edit → Preferences → Drivers → `wintab`**, desactivar Windows Ink en HuionTablet, reiniciar Pixelorama. Si no pinta, probar **`dummy`**. El MCP no puede cambiar ese driver.
